rationale: Error Correction (behavioral): Human challenges/verifies AI outputs. Requires nuanced judgment of verification depth. LLM-only.
Error Awareness (metacognitive): Detecting whether human recognizes AI errors. Requires understanding of implicit doubt signals. LLM-only.
Independent Reasoning (metacognitive): Distinguishing human's own thinking from parroted AI output. Requires nuanced text comparison. Candidate SetFit, but high variance → LLM for stability.
High-Stakes Review (behavioral): Multi-axis verification on consequential decisions. Requires understanding of decision stakes and review depth. LLM-only.
Justification Evaluation (behavioral): Human drives multi-turn explanation chains. Requires understanding of logical soundness. LLM-only.
Verification Markers (structural): Counts explicit verification words ('is that correct', 'let me verify', 'that's wrong', 'citation'). Deterministic counter.
Interrogative Ratio (structural): Ratio of question-ending sentences to affirmative sentences. Deterministic ratio computation.
Value Judgment Independence (behavioral): Human retains own ethical stance vs. deferring to AI. Requires understanding of value framing. LLM-only.
Unverified Confident Claims (structural): Fires when AI is confident (low hedging score) AND human shows zero verification markers. Deterministic scoring.
Handles Uncertainty (behavioral): Human acknowledges and responds to AI's explicit uncertainty. Nuanced judgment. LLM-only.
Factual Grounding (behavioral): Human grounds AI output in facts/sources. Requires understanding of evidentiary standards. LLM-only.
